items.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Unveils Five Layer AI Plan And Live Telesurgery Demo
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical revealed a five layer AI framework for its surgical platforms. The company showed a live real time telesurgical collaboration across distant facilities as part of the rollout. The news outlines how Intuitive plans to weave AI into clinical workflows rather than treat it as a standalone add on. For investors tracking Intuitive Surgical, ticker NasdaqGS:ISRG, this AI reveal comes at a time when the stock has faced pressure, with the share price at $332.02 and down 40.9%...
